notes.title: Server Migration Update
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Community,[/h2]
[b]
Bohnanza the Duel[/b] is migrated to our new server!

Here is a list of information about the transfer of the game from the old to the new server:

[b]Account migration[/b]
Everybody who owns our new server games (Gaia Project, Viticulture, Chai, Patchwork, Terra Mystica, Castles of Burgundy, Indian Summer, Cottage Garden, Le Havre, …) is already present on our new server. All others will now have the possibility to migrate their account also by updating Bohnanza the Duel with the coming update.

[b]How is it done, what will be migrated?[/b]
Simply update Bohnanza the Duel and start the game.
By opening up your profile you will see that your name was migrated (it may take a short time for the server to get your info. We do not migrate the win/lose stats to the new server).
If your former name was taken by someone else you will find an add on to the name after your old one. If you created a new one with for example Gaia Project already, your ID token will be recognized and the Username of the already existing Account will be used.
Avatars need to be altered after migration ( as before all avatars of your owned games will appear).
If you own other games that are still on the old server you will see a placeholder with blank statistics. As soon as those games are migrated the stats will start being included from a new.

[b]Friend list[/b]
Please read this carefully… Your friend list will be migrated BUT it will only show entries of friends that completely migrated already to the new server!
Users that do not download the new version and log into their account at least once will not be shown in the friend list.

[b]Ranking[/b]
Will NOT be migrated. We will start a new ranking season on the new server. There will be a top 100 legacy ranking list to still honor the most successful players of the old server ranking list.
Ranking will only show those who already logged in at least once with the new client.

[b]Replays[/b]
We do not migrate saved replays of the account. The feature remains, though.

[b]Running games[/b]
Will not be migrated. Your local games will still be accessible since they are saved locally on your device.

You can also find this information on our [url=https://digidiced.com/bohnanzatheduel-cc/]website[/url]
If you have any question regarding the migration process you can  contact our support via the contact form on our website.

Your DIGIDICED Team

notes.title: Update to Version 19
notes.content:
- changed the background color for the chat to increase readability
- decreased scroll view size, to ensure that the Bohn-O-Meter of each card stack is readable
- The Bohn-O-Meter at the bottom of the card stack now highlights the reward for harvesting
- discarding Bohnuscards now skips automatically when there are no Bohnus Cards to discard
- the local player can no longer be removed from local games
- the confirm move button is no longer active during Bohnuscard completion
- fixed a logic bug where you could prematurely end the gifting phase and put the game in a stuck state. Affected local games are sadly lost, online game affected must load without replay to be able to continue
